name: CONDO_AREA
description:
This dataset contains 1,263 sampled records describing condominium units and their associated spatial and structural attributes. Each row represents a condo unit, identified through fields such as base_bbl, unit_bbl, unit_lot, unit_designation, and condo_key, with a building identification number (bin) linking units to their parent structures. The data includes elevation and height measurements (elevation, base_height, top_height, room_height), floor information (floor_text, floor_num), and room descriptions (room_desc), along with geometry-derived values (shape_area, shape_length). Metadata fields capture the model used, notes, and audit information such as created and last-edited users and dates.

The dataset could support analyses of building composition and unit-level characteristics, such as comparing unit sizes, floor placement, and room heights across condominiums, or linking units to their base buildings via BBL and BIN identifiers.
